title: docs(plugin-webhooks): re-anchor the dead tracker citation to the commit that decided it
body:
Part of #20596
Clause-②: no

## What changed

This is the sixteenth stage of the `domain:services` lane of the dead-citation sweep. It covers `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/**` and nothing else. By the seat's claim (`5909908590`), it is the next of the three single-site packages left in the lane, taken one package per stage. Later stages cover the other packages, so this PR says `Part of` and the card stays open.

Every comment or docblock site in scope that cited a tracker number answering 404 has been rewritten in ruling C+D's form C (comment 5749154545 on #19123), by the method of stages 1 to 15 (the latest is PR #20836, landed as `bbe03f406`). That is **1 site on 1 line in 1 file, covering 1 number**:

- `src/translations/index.ts:26`, the census's one site in this package at the base. No test comment, test string, source string or gate-invisible spelling in this package carries a dead number (see the supplementary reading below), so the census site is the whole population.

The rewritten line now cites the commit in this repository that decided what it describes: **1 commit sha**. No ADR or ruling record records that decision (see the per-number table), so ruling C's commit rung applies. No number was dropped.

Only a comment changed. The file keeps its line count (1 line out, 1 in), so no line citation into it moves. No code token moves (see the guard below). **No citation number is added**: the only tracker number on the added line is the live `#12069`, which already stood on it.

The rewritten line is byte-identical to the line the six sibling translation sets already carry (`plugin-approvals:26`, `plugin-audit:28`, `plugin-security:26`, `plugin-sharing:26`, `service-messaging:29`, `service-storage:29`), landed by stages 1, 2, 4, 6, 7 and 9.

**No changeset.** The rewritten docblock does not reach `dist`, and `dist` is byte-identical with and without the rewrite (see Changeset below), so this PR takes `skip-changeset`.

## Census: `plugin-webhooks`, before and after

**Instrument (A1).** The gate's own `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs --census --json`, read-only and unchanged. The count below is its `allocated-but-absent` findings under `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/`. Each run counts as a reading only because its board frontier equals the newest issue or pull-request number, read by a separate request just before and just after the run.

| reading | tree | board | whole-repo `allocated-but-absent` | plugin-webhooks sites | lines | files | numbers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | base `bbe03f406`, run 2026-09-30T11:09:05Z to 11:12:38Z | enumerated, 187 pages, frontier #20841 (newest #20841 before and after) | 748 | **1** | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| after | head `01312906e`, run 11:26:38Z to 11:30:05Z | enumerated, 187 pages, frontier #20843 (newest #20842 before; #20843 after, a pull request opened 11:29:02Z inside the run, so the frontier equals the newest at the run's end) | 747 | **0** | 0 | 0 | 0 |

The whole-repo drop is 1, exactly this diff's census site. The `resolves` tally is 33,194 in both runs, and `resolves-as-pull-request` (1,985) and `cross-repo-unjudged` (1,018) did not move either. Neither run was truncated or discarded: both enumerations read 187 pages at the newest frontier. The seat's census counted 1 here at `6bff748b`, and the base agrees: `6bff748b` is an ancestor of the base, and the one commit between them that touches this package's `src` (`7184436a4`, a re-translation of generated object leaves) does not touch `translations/index.ts:26`.

**Supplementary instrument, the whole scope.** The census does not read test files or strings. So a second reading runs the gate's own exported `extractCitations` (whole-file and comment-prose projections) and `namesThisRepository` over every `.ts` file under `plugin-webhooks/src` (34 files). It takes its verdicts from the before census's own board reading rather than from a second enumeration: a number is dead when that census reported it `allocated-but-absent`, and alive when the gate's own census-scope extraction judged it and the census did not report it. 4 numbers are covered by neither, because they stand only in test files. Each was read on its own through the read-only tools: `#10619` answers as an issue; `#8556`, `#13565` and `#15687` answer as pull requests. The probe's controls: `#11671` and the known issue `#10619` answer 404 on the pull-request endpoint.

| reading | citations | dead | src comment | test comment | src string | test string |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| before, `bbe03f406` | 369 | **1** | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| after, `01312906e` | 368 | **0** | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

Its src-comment column equals the census's 1, which is the control on the second instrument. The 368 live citations are the same in both readings (363 by the census's judgement, 5 by the single reads), none is cross-repo, none is unjudged, and the drop of 1 citation is exactly the rewritten site. A third, raw reading (every `#` followed by 2 to 6 digits, whatever surrounds it) finds 378 occurrences before and 377 after, the same drop of 1. The 9 tokens beyond the gate's grammar are the same before and after, and none is dead (see Acceptance notes).

## Per-number table

Sites and files count every dead occurrence in scope at the base (comments and strings, tests included).

| number | sites / files | rewritten / left | anchor: what it decided |

That is exactly what `:25-26` say. Its message names `#12069` but not `#11671`; its own diff names `#11671` on 16 added lines, the first of them its changeset's headline. `git blame` puts `:26` in `30928a615` (PR #12724, which wires the serving-time read of that companion into all nine bundle sets), a descendant of the anchor. Reused: stages 1, 2, 4, 6, 7 and 9 gave the identical line in six sibling packages this anchor |

The sha matches exactly one commit (`git rev-parse --disambiguate`, count 1) and is an ancestor of the base (`merge-base --is-ancestor`, exit 0; reverse leg, base against the anchor, exit 1; control legs exit 0: stage 1's landing `422db788a`, and the repository's root commit, 15,200 commits deep against the anchor's 3,802; the history is complete, `--is-shallow-repository` false, 15,201 commits). `#11671` answers 404 on the issues endpoint and on the pull-request endpoint, read one by one.

No ADR, `scripts/adr-anchors/` file or ruling record names `#11671`, `#12069` or the source-hash companion (`git grep` over `docs/adr` and `scripts/adr-anchors`: one unrelated `source-hash cache` hit in ADR-0080), so ruling C's first rung is empty.

## Wordings to check

- **Tag swap in place.** 「(maintainer ruling #12069 Option A, #11671)」 became 「(maintainer ruling #12069 Option A, commit 09b4f4e4e)」. It is the form, and the byte-identical line, the six sibling translation sets carry.

  - `package.json`, `tsconfig.json` and `tsup.config.ts` name none. `files[]` lists `README.md`, but the package has none.

## Mechanical guard: no code token moves

The guard compares, base `bbe03f406` against head, over the one touched `.ts` file:

- **Reading 1**, the TypeScript parser's leaf nodes (a `forEachChild` walk, so comments are trivia and JSDoc nodes are never visited). String and template literals are therefore read in full.
- **Reading 2**, the full token stream in parser context (a `getChildren` walk, so punctuation and keywords are included; JSDoc nodes skipped).

Results:

- Real run at the head `01312906e`: 50 base leaf tokens, **0 files with a token change** on either reading (exit 0).
- Comment control (「Recording alone changes nothing a user sees」 to 「... alters ...」): 0 files changed, as expected (exit 0).
- Positive control, a code token renamed (`undefined, zhCNGeneratedSourceHashes)` to `...SourceHashesX)`): DIFFER on the identifier in both readings (exit 1).
- Positive control, a string-literal key changed (`'es-ES'` to `'es-EZ'`): DIFFER on the string literal in both readings (exit 1).

Every mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode) under a shell trap that restores by absolute path, and each landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed). Each restore was proven byte-identical to the HEAD blob (`929fa19989e2`), with `git diff HEAD` empty and a clean tree afterwards.

## Changeset: none (`skip-changeset`)

`files[]` is `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, and the package is not private. Measured on the built package (A3), after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-webhooks...' build` at `01312906e`, where the package's own `tsup` ran and cleaned its output folder:

- The rewritten line, its whole docblock (`:22-55`, which sits on the unexported `const enSource`) and the old number appear in no `dist` file (0 in all 20, source maps included). Nor do its neighbours `:23`, `:25`, `:27` and `:30`, or a never-written negative phrase.
- Positive controls, text that does ship: `WebhooksTranslations` from this same file is in `index.js`, `index.cjs` and both translations chunks (8), and `zhCNGeneratedSourceHashes` is in both translations chunks (4). A docblock line of this package, `auto-enqueuer.ts:33` (「Enqueue callback into the shared `service-messaging` HTTP outbox (ADR-0018 M3).」), is in `index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts`.
- **Byte identity.** The package was rebuilt with the base line put back (through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with the file proven equal to the base blob `686646fac51d` during the leg), and again after the proven restore. The sha256 of all 20 `dist` files is identical in all three builds: JS entries, declaration files, chunks and source maps.

So nothing this PR rewrites is published, and a changeset would announce a change no consumer can observe. No `.changeset/*` file is added or touched.

## Gates (head `01312906e`)

- **Citation judging, as CI runs it:** `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs` exits 0 (「every citation this change adds resolves」). `pnpm check:issue-citations` exits 0 (self-test, 114 cases, 8 batteries).

  - All 65 of the dispatch list ran, each with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all 65 exit 0; none exited 3.
  - `--ran`, fed each command with its exit code, reports 50 derived, 50 run, 0 NOT MEASURED (a derived zero), 0 unrun, and exits 0.
  - A full `turbo run build` over `./packages/*` and `./packages/*/*` ran first under the shared verify lock (71 of 71 tasks), so no gate hit an unbuilt workspace.
- **Roster families the derivation lists outside its commands** (their rosters sit in a directory this diff touches): `pnpm check:authz-resolver`, `pnpm check:error-code-casing` and `pnpm check:filter-alias-parity`, plus `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, which the dispatch named. Each exits 0.
- **Tests and typecheck, under the verify lock, at `01312906e`:**
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks test`: 13 files pass and 160 tests pass, which is every tracked test file under `src/`.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks typecheck` exits 0, and `tsc --noEmit --listFiles` puts the touched file in the program (the config includes `src` and excludes no test file).
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks check:test-typecheck` exits 0 (0 files held in the package's debt ledger).
- **Lint, as a proven narrowing:** eslint with inline config disabled, over the touched `.ts` file, gives 1 file, 0 errors and 0 warnings (its `--format json` output). The file is in eslint's own population (not reported ignored; `dist/index.js`, the control, reads ignored). `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, as its own lines 327-328 state), so a comment edit here cannot move the verdict on any untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- **Control bytes:** `pnpm check:nul-bytes` exits 0, and a raw scan of the changed file for control bytes finds none.

## Acceptance notes

- **The gate-invisible spellings, grepped as the claim asked** (#20636, including the `clause #N` position). At the base and at the head, `#N-word` is on 0 lines. `#A/#B` is on 8 lines (8 second numbers), and every second number is live: `#8022` (3 lines), `#7986` (2) and `#8043` (2) by the census's own judgement, and `#8565` read on its own as a pull request. `option #N`, `clause #N` and URL-spelled links are on 0 lines. So the claim's 0 / 8 / 0 / 0 / 0 hold, and nothing dead hides behind them. The one other raw token beyond the grammar is `PD #12` at `auto-enqueuer.ts:919`, a Prime Directive ordinal the extractor excuses on purpose.
- **Outside-`src` residue.** Three dead numbers in files outside `src` and outside `files[]` (`#11671`, `#11351`, `#13176`, listed above) are left, as stages 13 to 15 left theirs. They ship nothing and move no gate.
- **The census instrument did not truncate in this stage.** Both enumerations read 187 pages at the newest frontier.
- **Anchor for the next stages:** `#11671` → `09b4f4e4e`. `service-realtime/src/translations/index.ts:27` still carries the dead number in the identical sentence.
- **Base.** The branch is on `main` at `bbe03f406`. `main` has since moved five commits (to `688ddef3c`). None touches `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks`, `scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` or `.changeset/config.json`.
